Rule: Student registration must support only G.C.E. A/L Grades 12 and 13; reject unsupported grades.
Initial selectable curriculum is Biological Science and Physical Science (Maths) only; other streams are future/uncommitted, not selectable as launch-available.
Students may choose one or more supported subjects only if the stream, syllabus availability and academic year permit them.
Persist each student/subject/academic-year choice in StudentSubject with a uniqueness control against duplicate active selections.
Subject selection is not paid class enrollment, and must never itself issue class access or an entitlement.
Account states include Pending Verification, Active, Locked, Suspended and Closed; recovery and logout must invalidate applicable sessions.
Registration and recovery must not reveal the existence of another person’s account through identity-enumeration responses.
Only approved, active teachers and their eligible public class offerings appear in discovery.
Teacher verification follows Draft → Submitted → Needs Information → Approved/Rejected/Suspended, recording actor, timestamp and reason for decisions.
Teachers cannot self-approve identity/qualification verification or publish paid offerings before approval.
Teacher listings may expose authorized subjects, medium, schedules, price and approved demo availability, not private evidence, rosters, payments or contacts.
Ratings remain disabled until a moderation, eligibility and anti-fraud policy is approved.
Teacher suspension prevents unauthorized new publishing; treatment of existing paid students requires an approved continuity policy.
Class demo is an optional free prerecorded preview linked to a teacher-owned ClassOffering, not a scheduled live trial booking.
Students may watch an approved demo or skip it; neither viewing nor completion can gate checkout, enrollment or live-class joining.
A ClassOffering may contain zero or more demo videos; missing, failed, withdrawn or pending demos must not block direct enrollment.
Approved, published, active demo media may be publicly previewed free; rejected, withdrawn or processing demos must not be playable.
Only approved teachers submit class-linked demos; content must record title, language/medium, media reference, duration, rights attestation and creator.
A demo uploader cannot approve their own demo; review and publish/withdraw actions require authorized reviewers and audit history.
Demo video storage and preview delivery must be isolated from paid class resources and XACT explanation media.
Demo preview must not create TrialBooking, OrderHeader, Enrollment, PaymentAttempt, paid Entitlement or reserve a batch seat.
Public demo viewer login requirement, viewing analytics, duration and rights policy are unresolved; do not require or track these without approval.
Transactional seat capacity applies only to actual paid enrollment; prevent duplicate seats, overbooking and double charges.
Each class offering/batch must carry authorized teacher, subject, medium, syllabus, price, capacity, timezone, schedule, lifecycle window and status.
Join credentials for live provider must be short-lived and issued only to authorized users within configured join windows.
Attendance records join/leave details; authorized corrections require an audit trail.
Class cancellation/rescheduling must notify affected students and apply an approved credit/refund policy; do not promise automatic refunds.
Class resources require validation/scanning and authorized class-linked access; revoked content must stop new distribution.
Private learning media must use protected object storage and short-lived backend-authorized links; guessed URLs must not bypass access.
Student tuition receipts are GMV; recognize UR GURU revenue separately as approved commission/direct fees only.
Checkout must disclose total/currency, charges, description, access period and applicable renewal/cancellation/refund terms before purchase.
An order contains auditable line items and payment attempts; client-side success redirect alone cannot grant paid access.
Gateway notifications must be authenticated, server-verified, replay/idempotency protected before any entitlement is created.
Repeated valid callbacks must result in one entitlement and correct, nonduplicated ledger postings.
Financial ledger is append-only; refunds, chargebacks and payout reversals create linked correcting entries, not silent edits.
Teacher earnings derive only from eligible paid enrollments using the approved commission base; reserves/disputes affect payout status.
Partial refunds must reconcile only relevant entitlement and earning portions under the approved policy, not invariably revoke an entire class.
Refund requests, authorized decisions, provider processing and resulting balance adjustments must be traceable.
Free demo previews cannot be sold as paid products or trigger order, payment attempt or paid entitlement.
Payout approval/reconciliation must be auditable; actual gateway payout and recurring capabilities depend on approved provider contracts.
Exact tuition commission percentage, calculation base, taxes, fees and recognition policy are not fixed.
XACT paid packs or subscriptions are proposals only; do not activate charges, prices or entitlements until sign-off.
XACT is the current assessment product name; Exam Munnodi is historical terminology, not a separate active product.
Question catalogue must retain source paper/year, subject, medium, rights evidence and attribution for each candidate source.
Canonical question concept is distinct from approved translation/option/answer-key versions; stable option identifiers survive display reordering.
Each Tamil, Sinhala and English translation requires independent academic approval and must not silently fall back to another medium.
Only rights-cleared, approved, active concept, translation and answer-key combinations may be used in practice and exams.
Question/key corrections create versioned records; previously attempted snapshots remain immutable and changes are auditable.
Students may practice by approved paper/year/subject/medium or configure mocks by available topics, difficulty, count and time presets.
Mock generation selects from eligible approved pool without duplicate canonical questions and explains insufficient inventory.
Generated attempt snapshot retains question/option order, translation/key versions, scoring-policy version, time limit and source references.
Backend is authoritative for exam start, deadline, autosave, submission and grading; client timer is display-only.
Attempt state is one of NotStarted, InProgress, Submitted, AutoSubmitted, Expired or Invalidated; resumability/grace requires configuration and audit.
Autosave retries must not lose server-confirmed answers; duplicate submission must create only one final result.
Results show approved score, correct/incorrect/unanswered, topic progress and history; answer reveal follows review policy.
Do not infer topic mastery where sample size is insufficient; coverage and limitations must be transparent.
Only authorized approved teachers may build, preview, version, publish and assign papers from a read-only approved bank.
Each assignment references immutable teacher paper version and authorized recipients; each recipient has a separate attempt/result.
Paper reuse creates a new assignment; historical paper versions, recipient attempts and scores are preserved.
Teacher score/answer-level access requires ownership or authorized assignment membership; regrades are audited.
XACT explanation video passes secure processing, academic/rights review and authorized publication; rejected/unprocessed media cannot publish.
Written explanation fallback remains when video is unavailable; XACT video entitlement differs from free class demo media.
Question count, duration, retries, marking, negative marks, reveal/grace and difficulty quotas require approved configuration.
Apply server-side role-based and object ownership/authorized-membership checks to protected operations; hiding UI alone is insufficient.
Student must not read other students’ profiles, payments, results, resources or class assets without authorization.
Guardian contact is used for consent/communications where legally applicable; no full guardian dashboard in current scope.
Where consent is legally required, preserve a revocable purpose-specific event, exact policy version and protected evidence.
Do not require NIC from every minor by default; NIC format validation is not government verification.
Restrict teacher identity/evidence, moderation notes and student viewing behavior from public listings or demo playback.
Source reproduction, translations, adaptation, teacher media and demo videos must have documented rights before publication.
Separate public approved demo delivery from entitlement-gated private resources and XACT explanation assets.
Avoid irreversible deletion of ledger entries, scored attempts and legally retained investigation data; use approved retention/archival rules.
Child safety complaints must remain confidential, auditable and restricted to authorized safeguarding handlers.
Tamil/Sinhala/English scientific formulae, units, diagrams and answer options must be legible and accessible in supported browsers.
Notification events must be independently trackable, retryable and avoid unnecessary personal details in email/SMS.
Outbox delivery and provider retries must recover from worker interruption without duplicate harmful effects.
Teacher verification, payment/refund, demo publication, question corrections and consent decisions need actor/time/status audit.
Finance reviewers approve authorized refunds/payouts; no unaudited manual ledger edits.
Support and safeguarding escalations require a controlled owner, restricted evidence and protected case history.
Proposed numerical performance/availability/RPO/RTO benchmarks are candidates, not production SLAs.
Operational monitoring covers live failures, payment mismatches, outbox backlog, exam autosave failures, videos and safety escalations.
